hf_snapshot_contract.global_preflight_scope: before the first model forward in any stage, verify both complete checkpoint snapshots together
hf_snapshot_contract.hash_authority: the five per-checkpoint SHA256 fields in models.math_base and models.r1_distill
hf_snapshot_contract.cache_location: resolved cache root must be strictly outside the dedicated clean sealed checkout: neither equal to it, contained by it, nor its ancestor
hf_snapshot_contract.path_policy: every required snapshot, lens, task, code, test, and requirements path must resolve to an ordinary regular file and the required path itself must not be a symbolic link
verification_points: global sealed preflight before any forward
hf_snapshot_contract.tokenizer_loading: eligibility, boundaries, behaviour, and model stages load only the already-verified local tokenizer files with local_files_only semantics; no second unverified tokenizer resolution
hf_snapshot_contract.ordinary_prefix_identity_gate: before model work, for all 55 order-ops prompt/target pairs require identical add_special_tokens=false causal-prefix IDs and identical boundary offsets across the two verified tokenizers; apply the distill fit-compatible BOS only after this check

order_ops.label_null_population: the fixed, fully complete 50-item annotation-valid non-lexically-present primary; all 50 items in the observed statistic and every null draw; unresolved technical failure stops the stage
order_ops.label_null_decision: 99,999 PCG64 draws; method=higher q95; require observed strictly greater than q95 and +1 upper p=(1+count[null>=observed])/100000 <=0.05

annotation_exclusions.mult-div-mult: numeric partial 12 is followed by division, not the supplied multiplication label; source bytes retained, rank extraction retained, excluded from every O1 readout-analysis denominator while the separate target-answer behavioural audit remains all 55

order_ops_synonyms.numeric_rule: decimal digits plus lowercase English cardinal for integers 0-999, no 'and', tens hyphenated

readout.boundary_locator: tokenize exact prompt+target without specials and offsets; find first token overlapping target character interval; forward only ID prefix through predecessor; prepend only the checkpoint-specific fit_compatible_bos when non-null
readout.primary_score_definition: mean over source layers 9..17 of indicator that the frozen synonym-family rank is <=25
readout.ranked_vocabulary: tokenizer ID prefix 0..151664 including special IDs; padded head rows excluded
readout.label_eligibility: single token, ID in ranked vocabulary, special IDs excluded
readout.primary_precision: BF16 model forward; FP32 residual and J; D5-style deep-copied FP32 final norm and LM head
readout.precision_sensitivity: ordinary BF16 final norm and LM head top-25

orderops_pair_pattern_vocabulary.hedge_rule: failure of the DiD material-recurrence criterion does not establish that a qualifying J recurrence is transport-nonspecific

behaviour.tokenization: add_special_tokens=false; no manual BOS for either checkpoint; readout-only distill BOS is not used
behaviour.stored_continuation: generated token IDs only, with a terminal EOS ID removed before decoding
behaviour.atomic_and_direct_stop: first of EOS, first LF in the incrementally decoded continuation, or token cap; score only text before LF
behaviour.orderops_cot_wrapper: Solve this arithmetic problem step by step and end with the final answer: "{prompt}"
behaviour.orderops_cot_stop: first of EOS or token cap; newline does not stop
behaviour.target_alias_rule: numeric target gets decimal and canonical cardinal forms; nonnumeric target gets casefolded source form only
behaviour.cot_primary_matcher: CRLF-to-LF; final nonempty line; Unicode NFKC; whitespace collapse; trim enclosing quotes and terminal punctuation; casefold; escaped alias under Unicode (?<!\w)alias(?!\w) boundaries
behaviour.cot_sensitivity_matcher: same bounded matcher over the entire normalized continuation
behaviour.teacher_forced_logprob: exact raw prompt+target, add_special_tokens=false and no manual BOS; offset-overlap target tokens; report sum and mean

typo_control.readout: exact raw prompt; add_special_tokens=false; fit-compatible BOS none for math_base and 151646 for r1_distill; final prompt token; O1 source layers, vocabulary, exact ranks, and D5 FP32 path
typo_control.observed_statistic: per checkpoint mean any-source-layer J-Lens top-25 union over frozen typo label family
typo_control.null: permute whole 96 typo families among prompts, synchronized across checkpoints and layers, preserving duplicates; 99,999 PCG64 draws; method=higher q95; +1 upper p
typo_control.integrity_threshold: each checkpoint union >=0.75, strictly above null q95, and upper p<=0.05

pure_test_receipt.selection: the sealed tests/test_jspace_1p5b_atomic_orderops.py pure-code test file
pure_test_receipt.resume_rule: byte-identical stable receipt required; volatile pytest timing or presentation cannot affect equality

derivation_manifest_scope.direct_inputs: protocol, input lock, requirements lock, bundle manifest and every file it names (including fit-provenance records), frozen task and upstream evaluation files, runner, pure tests, jspace_phase1_scoring.py, both lenses, every file named by hf_snapshot_contract.required_files_per_checkpoint for both checkpoints, every campaign-authority file, the selected arm's STAGE_SELECTED.json, and RANKS_COMPLETE as a direct input to O1 analysis
derivation_manifest_scope.outputs: every final evidence payload and stage manifest before the completion marker
derivation_manifest_scope.completion_binding: the completion marker hashes the validated derivation manifest, stage manifest, and every final evidence payload; it is not recursively included inside the derivation manifest

a0_supportive_bootstrap.unit: paired resampling of the full 81-item index vector
a0_supportive_bootstrap.state_cell_outputs: for each cell, checkpoint-specific proportions and paired distill-minus-base proportion difference, each with percentile 95% interval
a0_supportive_bootstrap.common_known_gate: run only when observed count with K_math_base=K_r1_distill=1 is at least 20
a0_supportive_bootstrap.common_known_outputs: checkpoint-specific composed-success rates and paired distill-minus-base risk difference, each with percentile 95% interval
a0_supportive_bootstrap.derived_subset_rule: inside every draw recompute the common-known mask over resampled draw positions from the H1/H2 outcomes, retaining duplicate sampled items; never reuse observed membership
a0_supportive_bootstrap.empty_draw_rule: if any of the fixed 20,000 draws has an empty recomputed common-known set, withhold the conditional interval and report the failure; do not redraw, delete, or impute

execution_fingerprint.freeze_scope: one campaign authority and fingerprint is frozen before either A0 or O1 forwards; both stages, both checkpoint cells, every partial, and the sole permitted resume must byte-match it
execution_fingerprint.dtype: bfloat16 model forward; FP32 residual/Jacobian transport and D5 readout where registered
execution_fingerprint.bf16_probe: deterministic BF16 allocation and arithmetic probe with a stable result digest; CUDA additionally requires torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(); MPS additionally requires a built and available backend on macOS 14+; CPU execution is forbidden; this is an operational execution-support gate rather than a hardware-native-unit claim
execution_fingerprint.mismatch_rule: stop; never combine cells or resume partials across a fingerprint mismatch

campaign_authority.creation: the sealed campaign CLI stage writes one immutable UUID directory containing seal.json, preflight.json, campaign_manifest.json, and CAMPAIGN_READY plus an immutable parent-level CAMPAIGN_SELECTED.json before any model forward; a second sibling authority is forbidden
campaign_authority.path_binding: canonical campaign UUID and resolved path are stored in the manifest, ready marker, selection pointer, and run reference; copying or relocating the directory fails validation
campaign_authority.stage_binding: atomic and orderops each require the same uniquely selected explicit --campaign-dir, byte-compare a fresh sealed preflight with that authority, and bind its hashes into run identity, every partial, and derivation manifests
campaign_authority.analysis_binding: analysis revalidates the rank run's retained campaign reference and includes CAMPAIGN_SELECTED.json and every selected-authority file as direct derivation inputs

stage_selection_authority.creation: the first fresh atomic or orderops invocation creates exactly one UUID run directory and one sibling STAGE_SELECTED.json before any model forward
stage_selection_authority.binding: the pointer binds the stage, canonical run ID and path, seal, preflight, campaign authority, and campaign selection; it is included in run identity, every partial through the execution binding, and every stage derivation
stage_selection_authority.uniqueness: the stage parent must contain exactly the pointer and selected run; a second fresh invocation is forbidden, and later access is limited to verification, deterministic O1 analysis, or the sole technical resume of that exact selected run

completeness_and_retry.atomic_required: 81/81 items with H1, H2, M and continuity for both checkpoints
completeness_and_retry.orderops_readout_required: rank extraction on 54/54 common-token-eligible rows for both checkpoints; all analysis summaries exclude mult-div-mult's mismatched paired annotation; frozen 50-item annotation-valid subset is primary
completeness_and_retry.orderops_behavior_required: 55/55 Direct, CoT, and teacher-forced items for both checkpoints
completeness_and_retry.technical_retry: one explicit byte-identical resume, allowed only after a valid atomically written stage_exception record; retain original exception and resume event; no second resume; otherwise stop without scientific report
completeness_and_retry.nonresumable_cases: ordinary interruption, orphan partial, missing or invalid stage_exception, already-consumed resume event, or any seal/input/config/preflight/device mismatch
completeness_and_retry.partial_payload_validation: before loading and before promotion require exact schema/stage version; seal, input, configuration, preflight, execution-fingerprint and completed-prefix digests; ordered item/model/method/layer/label identifiers; exact expected array names, shapes, dtypes and counts; finite score domains; ranks in vocabulary bounds; top-25 cardinality, bounds and within-row uniqueness; complete behavioural record fields; and canonical-payload SHA256
completeness_and_retry.partial_prefix_definition: non-recursive SHA256 over the run-specific execution binding (including run UUID/path and campaign authority), ordered completed semantic identifiers, and canonical payload SHA256; prevents transplantation between otherwise identical runs
completeness_and_retry.final_payload_validation: producer and analysis consumer independently re-read and apply the full partial-payload structural checks plus manifest-recorded file SHA256; filename or marker presence alone is insufficient
completeness_and_retry.completion_protocol: atomically promote and revalidate final payloads, then atomically write and validate stage and derivation manifests, then atomically write a completion marker binding their SHA256 and every final evidence SHA256, and only then remove the incomplete marker; O1 rank extraction and O1 analysis use separate explicit output namespaces in their shared directory, rank excludes later analysis-owned report.json/REPORT.md/derivation_manifest.json, analysis binds exactly report.json and REPORT.md and consumes RANKS_COMPLETE directly, and both authorities must remain independently revalidatable
completeness_and_retry.completion_recovery: both markers may coexist after a crash and count as complete only after all completion bindings revalidate; absent a valid completion marker, preserve unbound final-looking files as recovery evidence and idempotently rerun deterministic finalization/analysis; a valid complete stage is immutable and repeated invocation only verifies it
completeness_and_retry.missing_case_analysis: none; no complete-case deletion, denominator adaptation, or imputation

preseal_leakage_audit.scope: local filenames and repository text searched before seal; task definitions and provenance only were inspected

seal_commit.definition: the first git commit containing the complete protocol, input lock, frozen atomic task file, requirements lock, bundle manifest, runner, and tests
